rules.trigger_condition: No heartbeat received from edge device for > 3 consecutive polling intervals (> 90 s)
rules.recommended_action: Page OT support; check power/network to the device; verify process is running; fail over to redundant node if available.

rules.trigger_condition: Edge GPU temperature > 85 C sustained for > 2 minutes
rules.recommended_action: Inspect cabinet cooling; reduce inference load or shed non-critical models; schedule maintenance if recurring.

rules.trigger_condition: Edge node disk usage > 85% on buffer partition
rules.recommended_action: Verify store-and-forward draining; expand retention policy; clear old buffers; investigate stalled upload.

rules.trigger_condition: Edge CPU usage > 90% sustained for > 5 minutes
rules.recommended_action: Review workloads for runaway processes; rebalance models across nodes; scale edge compute if persistent.

rules.trigger_condition: Edge memory usage > 90% sustained for > 5 minutes
rules.recommended_action: Investigate memory leaks; restart affected services; resize node memory if recurring.

rules.trigger_condition: Machine-to-dashboard end-to-end latency > 10 s for > 5 consecutive minutes
rules.recommended_action: Check for ingestion backlog or slow transforms; inspect broker and historian queues; scale consumers if needed.

rules.trigger_condition: Data completeness for an asset or line < 95% over 15 minutes
rules.recommended_action: Identify missing tags; check sensors, gateways, and connectivity; verify protocol bridges; flag affected intervals low-confidence.

rules.trigger_condition: Data ingestion rate deviates > 3 sigma from baseline for > 10 minutes
rules.recommended_action: Investigate the deviating source; check for device floods or silent failure; reconcile against expected tag counts.

rules.trigger_condition: Historian write failure rate > 0.5% over 5 minutes
rules.recommended_action: Check historian capacity and disk; verify tag schema; inspect for rejected/duplicate writes; engage platform on-call.

rules.trigger_condition: Line OEE drops below target minus 5 points sustained over a shift-to-date window
rules.recommended_action: Drill into availability/performance/quality; identify the dominant loss reason; dispatch the relevant team (maintenance/quality/ops).

rules.trigger_condition: Asset or line enters unplanned downtime for > 2 minutes
rules.recommended_action: Trigger downtime reason capture; notify maintenance; start MTTR clock; engage PdM insight if available.

rules.trigger_condition: First-pass yield deviates below rolling mean minus 2 sigma over 1 hour
rules.recommended_action: Run root-cause diagnostics; check material lots and process parameters; isolate affected period for review.

rules.trigger_condition: Scrap rate exceeds rolling mean plus 3 sigma over 30 minutes
rules.recommended_action: Halt or quarantine affected output if critical; investigate defect source; engage quality and process engineering.

rules.trigger_condition: Line throughput falls below 90% of expected rate sustained for > 30 minutes
rules.recommended_action: Identify the bottleneck station; check for micro-stops and buffer starvation; review operator logs.

rules.trigger_condition: Production model mean prediction confidence drops below threshold for > 15 minutes
rules.recommended_action: Check for input drift; verify upstream data quality; engage safe-state fallback if needed; review with model owner.

rules.trigger_condition: Model performance metric or output distribution drift exceeds threshold (PSI > 0.2)
rules.recommended_action: Trigger retraining workflow; validate candidate model; plan redeployment; keep last validated model in production.

rules.trigger_condition: Input feature drift (PSI) > 0.2 on a monitored feature
rules.recommended_action: Investigate process/material change; correlate with events; assess model impact and schedule retraining.

rules.trigger_condition: p95 model inference latency exceeds real-time budget for > 5 minutes
rules.recommended_action: Check edge compute load and batching; optimize or offload model; scale edge resources if persistent.

rules.trigger_condition: Model prediction count drops below 50% of baseline for > 15 minutes
rules.recommended_action: Verify upstream data flow and model service health; check edge connectivity; resume once data restored.

rules.trigger_condition: Unusual outbound traffic from OT zone exceeding baseline plus 3 sigma to non-approved destinations
rules.recommended_action: Investigate source; block anomalous destinations; isolate device; initiate incident response if confirmed.

rules.trigger_condition: Detected change to controller logic/firewall/access config without a matching approved change ticket
rules.recommended_action: Verify change ticket; revert if unauthorized; forensically review; tighten change control.

rules.trigger_condition: Failed login attempts on OT systems exceed threshold (e.g., 5 in 5 minutes) per account or host
rules.recommended_action: Review source; lock or reset account if needed; check for credential compromise; monitor for escalation.

rules.trigger_condition: Firewall or segmentation rule change without a matching approved Change Advisory Board ticket
rules.recommended_action: Validate against CAB log; revert if unauthorized; review segmentation posture; escalate to security and OT governance.

rules.trigger_condition: High or critical EDR/AV alert raised on an OT-zone asset
rules.recommended_action: Isolate affected asset; investigate indicator; run OT incident response; remediate and validate before reconnecting.

rules.trigger_condition: OT system has known CVEs without available patches, exposing unmitigated vulnerabilities in production
rules.recommended_action: Engage vendor for patch status; implement compensating controls (segmentation, monitoring); track remediation timeline.

rules.trigger_condition: Pilot phase exceeds 90-day timeline without measurable OEE or yield improvement on the pilot line
rules.recommended_action: Review pilot scope and baseline data; escalate to steering committee; assess whether to pivot or extend scope.

rules.trigger_condition: Project budget burn rate exceeds planned by > 15% for two consecutive months during Phase 4 or 5
rules.recommended_action: Review change order log and scope creep; engage PMO for re-forecast; escalate to steering committee.

rules.trigger_condition: Punch list or commissioning checkpoints > 20% open within 2 weeks of scheduled go-live date
rules.recommended_action: Assess go/no-go decision; accelerate close-out sprint; engage stakeholders on timeline risk; document risk acceptance for deferred items.
